title: WildWorld
description: Appreciating the scenery while challenging this world full of monsters
body: 1.zh_cn: 如果你觉得原版我的世界太简单太无聊，那么就来这个风景优美，又充满危机的世界吧。 在这里，你开局只有3颗心和3颗饱食度， 而且每隔5天的晚上就会有一次月亮异象，有怪物被强化的血月，有地狱入侵的幻月，有作物增益的黄月，还有非常安全且刷新动物的蓝月。 Deep Underworld:钻石装备需前往地下世界的刷怪笼箱子里寻找物品。更多机制请查看模组。 但不用担心，击败怪物，或者挖掘钻石、绿宝石等，右键即可食用来增加你的经验， 每增加5级经验，你的生命值和饱食度就会随之增加， 如果遇到危险，还可以将经验存储起来，随时可以取用。 你还可以合成一个领地方块，放下后创建自己的领地，然后使用【右Alt】键搬家。 你还可以用自己名字的命名牌右键一个箱子来锁定它。 更有大量遗迹等着你探索， 最终，你的任务就是前往末地维度，打败增强化的末影龙。 2.en_us: If you think the original version of minecraft is too simple and boring, come to this beautiful and crisis filled world. Here, you start with only 3 hearts and 3 satiety points, And every 5 nights, there will be a moon vision, including a blood moon strengthened by monsters, a phantom moon invaded by hell, a yellow moon enhanced by crops, and a very safe and refreshing blue moon that refreshes animals. Deep Underworld:Diamond equipment crafting item can be found in the chest of the monster spawner in the Underworld.More information ，please see the mod. But don't worry, defeat monsters or mine diamonds, emeralds, etc. Right click to consume and increase your experience, For every additional 5 levels of experience, your health and satiety will increase accordingly, If encountering danger, experience can also be stored and accessed at any time. You can also craft a house block ，then place it to set up a house ,and click the right Alt key to move your house . You also can use the name_tag of your name to right click a chest to set your private chest container. There are also numerous relics waiting for you to explore, Ultimately, your task is to travel to the End Dimension and defeat the enhanced End Dragon.
